source: Chemin-de-fer - railway. You know it?
translation: Chemin-de-fer——铁路。你懂吗？
notes: Chemin-de-fer 既是法语“铁路”也是牌戏名，保留法语并直陈字面义以维持双关。

source: ... I don't know. It's unknowable. So I don't know.
translation: ……不知道。这无从知道。所以，我不知道。

source: Lulled by the train's sway, I slip into a deep sleep...
translation: 火车摇着摇着，我便沉沉睡去……

source: [Read]
translation: [阅读]

source: This document would be satisfactory... except that you told me, earlier, that your name was [q=alias.last]. This is an entirely different name.
translation: 这份证件原本没有问题……只不过你早些时候告诉我，你姓 [q=alias.last]。这上面是个完全不同的名字。
notes: 保留 [q=alias.last] 变量。

source: Aristide. Please.
translation: 阿里斯蒂德。拜托。

source: Much better.
translation: 好多了。

source: Mm. I hope you found your seaside stay restful.
translation: 嗯。希望你在海边休养得不错。

source: [Odd that she was so reluctant to offer this...]
translation: [奇怪，她怎么这么不愿意拿出这个……]

source: Good to be on the move again. I think I might have outstayed my welcome, here!
translation: 又能上路，真好。我想自己在这里待得太久，已经不招人待见了！

source: I noticed some, ah, gaps in Antibes. Do you know what they are?
translation: 我注意到昂蒂布有一些，呃，缺口。你知道那是什么吗？

source: I'm sorry.
translation: 抱歉。

source: Night campaign.
translation: 夜战。
notes: 结合奥比耶询问从军经历的上下文，Night campaign 直译“夜战”，保留含混和主角的简短应答。

source: Pillows straight. There.
translation: 枕头摆正。好了。

source: An Hour of forbidden appetites. He inspires his votaries to consume the flesh of the dead...
translation: 一位司掌禁忌欲望的司辰。他会激励信徒食用死者之肉……

source: A complicated memory stirs...
translation: 一段复杂的记忆翻涌……

source: Lay a hand on the bear's fur.
translation: 把手放在熊的毛皮上。

source: He called the owl 'Ubu'.
translation: 他叫那只猫头鹰“乌布”。

source: 'The gate to its temenos is a beast-image in the hidden chamber of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui...'
translation: “通往其圣域的门，是名为‘今日’的疗养院隐秘房间里的一尊兽像……”
notes: temenos 指神圣围域，译“圣域”；Sanitarium Aujourd'hui 沿前批译“‘今日’疗养院”。；开放终审：按完整词形族与当前句法统一。

source: With the right tools - or the right assistance - his dreams might be open to me.
translation: 有合适的工具——或合适的协助——我或许能进入他的梦。

source: One Charlemagne asked: how can you stand to wear American uniforms?
translation: 一个查理曼师士兵反问：那你们又怎么受得了穿美国制服？
notes: Charlemagnes 指敌军占领时期查理曼师的法国志愿兵，明确译“查理曼师士兵”。

source: Nothing. Good day.
translation: 没什么。日安。

source: Your turn.
translation: 轮到你了。

source: Jaume's eyes crinkle in his habitual melancholy nearly-smile.
translation: 豪梅眼角微皱，露出他惯常忧郁、近乎微笑的神情。
notes: v1.2.5 术语终审：依最新版术语证据统一。

source: In some buildings, there are doors that appear on no plan, through which only the drunk or distracted ever pass. Is there one here?
translation: 有些建筑里存在图纸上没有的门，只有醉汉或心不在焉的人会穿过去。这里也有一扇吗？

source: This Nina - what does she look like?
translation: 这个宁娜——她长什么样？

source: Mademoiselle, I am invariably careful.
translation: 小姐，我向来小心。

source: [Yes, this is clearly acceptable. Quite acceptable.]
translation: [是的，显然还算合意。相当合意。]

source: Thanks, Bessy.
translation: 谢谢，贝茜。

source: The work of moments to brush a little bewitchment around the rims of the glasses.
translation: 只消片刻，几只杯沿便沾上了一层淡淡的惑心术。
notes: bewitchment 沿本批 Bewitch／Bewitching 开放终审采用“惑心术”。；开放终审：按完整词形族与当前句法统一。

source: I apologise for my flippancy, Mr Strathcoyne.
translation: 请原谅我的轻率，斯特拉思科因先生。
notes: flippancy 指前句从耳后变硬币的轻率玩笑，避免译成带调情色彩的“轻佻”。

source: [Linou's grin becomes wolfish.]
translation: [莉努咧嘴一笑，露出狼相。]

source: [Pay five hundred francisques, let Vincent go third class] I'll see you in Mimata.
translation: [支付五百弗朗西斯克，让文森特乘三等座] 米马塔见。
notes: francisque 依前批开放终审采用“弗朗西斯克”。

source: Come to think of it, I saved his leg.
translation: 这么说来，他那条腿还是我救下的。

source: I suspect it's too mystical for me, also. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 恐怕对我来说也太玄乎了。我们谈点别的吧。

source: It's safer and wiser not to stand out too much.
translation: 不太引人注目，才更安全，也更明智。

source: And do not mention the name of Milicien Léon.
translation: 还有，别提民兵莱昂的名字。
notes: Milicien 依政治语境译“民团士兵”。；润色2026-08-18：Milicien Léon 统一为“民兵莱昂”

source: Precisely. To name only a single consequence. But a consequence of what? That is what we discuss.
translation: 正是。这还只是其中一个后果。但它是什么造成的后果？这才是我们讨论的问题。

source: Waking from Mansus-dreams is often painfully abrupt. Like falling from the sky - or being cast up on a cold shore under a cold sun.
translation: 从漫宿之梦中醒来，往往突兀得令人痛苦。像从空中坠落——或是被抛上一片寒冷的海岸，头顶悬着一轮冰冷的太阳。
notes: Mansus 依术语表译“漫宿”。

source: She's the patron saint of the city, and of... fishermen? Sailors?
translation: 她是这座城的守护圣人，也是……渔民的？还是水手的？

source: I can't quite recall when I first heard the tale...
translation: 我不太记得最早是什么时候听到这个故事的了……
notes: 两个共用语境均适用。

source: I have the skills to create a Withering item - if I want.
translation: 我有制作凋萎物品的技艺——只要我愿意。
notes: Withering 依前批系统术语译“凋萎”。

source: I could use a coffee.
translation: 我想喝杯咖啡。

source: [Truth] I know in my heart that I need to find her.
translation: [实话] 我心里清楚，我必须找到她。
notes: 两个共用语境均适用。

source: These three are pretty clear, actually - they'll allow me to set an alarm to wake me.
translation: 其实，这三项很明白——能设个闹钟，把我叫醒。

source: Very good, [q=alias.familiar]. But now we have to take the rest of your money.
translation: 很好，[q=alias.familiar]。不过现在，我们得把你剩下的钱也赢走。
notes: 保留称呼变量。

source: [Something unclear, here.]
translation: [这里有些东西不太清楚。]
notes: 开发占位文本。

source: The Director has a second office behind the mirror in his office, where he keeps his records.
translation: 院长办公室的镜子后面还藏着一间办公室，档案就放在那里。
notes: 保留原文刻意重复 office 的信息。；润色2026-08-18：疗养院 Director 统一为“院长”（chunk_002 定译）

source: No matter. How may I assist you?
translation: 无妨。我能如何帮助您？

source: I said that the [[Enemy]] disliked swing. But not all of them. They let the Roulotte stay open late, you know? The men in grey. So they could listen to Reinhardt.
translation: 我说过，[[Enemy]]不喜欢摇摆乐。不过也不全是。那些穿灰衣的人就准许鲁洛特营业到很晚——好让他们听莱因哈特。
notes: 专名统一：La Roulotte 译“鲁洛特”。

source: [But really, just pick the option that suits you. The game works best when you do that.]
translation: [不过说真的，只管选择最合你心意的选项。这样玩，游戏的体验最好。]
notes: 教程文本采用直接清晰语气。

source: Reluctantly. My Mimis, and myself - in Epirus we made our home, and there his bones remain. Poor Epirus has fallen to a double scourge. The doctor offered help with my condition, when I fled the city's fall.
translation: 很不情愿。我的米米斯和我——我们曾在伊庇鲁斯安家，他的遗骨也留在那里。可怜的伊庇鲁斯遭受了双重灾祸。城陷之时我逃了出来，医生答应帮助我处理自己的状况。
notes: Mimis 为亡夫昵称，开放终审采用“米米斯”；double scourge 所指未明，保留含混。

source: [Join the card game.]
translation: [加入牌局。]

source: The keystone of civilisation; the world's deep heart.
translation: 文明的拱心石；世界深处的心。
notes: 保留 keystone 与 deep heart 的物质意象。

source: [A moment of peace. Perhaps more than a moment.]
translation: [片刻安宁。也许不止片刻。]
notes: 两个共用语境均适用。

source: Aubière cracks open a new notebook, clicks a clean chrome ballpoint pen, and excitedly jots down a note.
translation: 奥比耶翻开一本崭新的笔记本，咔哒按出一支锃亮的镀铬圆珠笔，兴奋地记下一笔。

source: When I look up at the blood on the sun, the pallor of the sky, when I think about what's been lost...
translation: 当我仰望太阳上的血、天空的苍白，当我想起那些已经失去的事物……
notes: 保留病变天空的并列意象。

source: Yes! To the sea!
translation: 是的！去海边！

source: I have wasted enough words with you. Go.
translation: 我已经在你身上浪费了够多口舌。走吧。

source: Very well.
translation: 很好。
notes: 三个共用语境均适用。

source:
Who'd do anything just for the sake of doing it? Only the wind moves without a reason.

[You've rejected the Whimsy Passion. If you act Whimsically again you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation:
谁会只为了做而去做？只有风才会无缘无故地行动。

[你拒绝了奇想心念。若你再次凭奇想行事，只要还有空余的心念栏位，就会有机会重新考虑。]
notes: Whimsy/Passion/Passion slot 依前批统一译“奇想／心念／心念栏位”。

source: A pity the [[Mansus]] is barred to us both. We could walk in the Orchard of Lights... but the War in the Sun has denied us that joy. We must take what we can from what's left.
translation: 可惜[[Mansus]]把你我拒之门外。我们本可漫步光之果园……太阳之战却夺走了这份欢愉。如今剩下什么，便取什么吧。
notes: 保留链接结构；War in the Sun 依术语表译“太阳之战”，Orchard of Lights；开放终审：服从前作官中或逐词证据链，修正设定称谓。

source: [Lie] Say rather a friendly campfire, Aristide. [Nod at his pipe.] I'll see you again.
translation: [说谎] 不如说，是一簇友善的篝火，阿里斯蒂德。[朝他的烟斗点点头。] 我们会再见。

source: Wait. I'm not ready after all.
translation: 等等。说到底，我还没准备好。

source: Change from Medea to Nina
translation: 从美狄亚切换至宁娜
notes: 开发测试文本。

source: [The bookseller raises her gaze from the newspaper.]
translation: [书商从报纸上抬起目光。]

source: She had owned that songbird almost a year. I recall that she had to crush its throat and cut its heart out with a pocket-knife. To prove her conviction - or perhaps only because the one she called was one who liked that kind of thing.
translation: 她养了那只鸣禽将近一年。我记得，她必须捏碎它的喉管，再用小刀剜出它的心脏。为证明自己的决心——也或许只是因为，她召来的那一位喜欢这种事。
notes: 保留仪式暴力的冷静叙述和召唤对象的含混。

source: La marquise flatters me.
translation: 侯爵夫人谬赞了。
notes: 保留富文本；法语称号按对话显示译出。

source: Fortunate; since we have in fact no coffee.
translation: 那倒走运，因为我们其实没有咖啡。

source: My study of silence has taught me ways to wake from sleep. [Wake at midnight.]
translation: 对静默的研习教会了我如何从睡梦中醒来。[在午夜醒来。]

source: Plays, poetry. One could call this collection 'eclectic'. One might suspect these are books chosen to be displayed, not read.
translation: 戏剧，诗歌。这批藏书姑且可称“兼收并蓄”。也不免令人怀疑：选这些书是为了陈列，不是为了读。
notes: eclectic 的引号保留含蓄讥讽。

source: In the corner of the room rears - somehow half-heartedly - a great brown bear.
translation: 房间一角，一头硕大的棕熊直立着——不知为何，立得有些有气无力。
notes: 语境为标本，保留 half-heartedly 的冷幽默。

source: Have you met anyone of that name?
translation: 你见过叫这个名字的人吗？

source: [Third class] Needs must in hard times.
translation: [三等座] 时世艰难，只得将就。
notes: Needs must 依语境意译。

source: That seems reasonable. [Pay her.]
translation: 听起来合理。[付钱给她。]

source: Monsieur must forgive Aristide's manners. He becomes foolish with his second glass.
translation: 先生得原谅阿里斯蒂德的无礼。他喝到第二杯就会犯傻。

source: My name is Fraser Strathcoyne. Did you have business with me?
translation: 我叫弗雷泽·斯特拉思科因。你找我有事？

source: Look through the notebook with my name.
translation: 翻看写着我名字的笔记本。

source: [Reveal All] She, ah, wanted to commission me to put a curse on you.
translation: [全盘托出] 她，呃，想委托我对你下咒。
notes: 2026.8.j.66 增量：对照新版资产、上下文与相邻旧译人工复核。

source: For a long time. We were both with the Légion.
translation: 认识很久了。我们都在军团待过。
notes: j.87 文本修订同步

source: It is. But do you mean to suggest, perhaps, that I am concealing something from you in this matter?
translation: 确实。不过，你难道是在暗示，我在这件事上对你有所隐瞒？

source: Any news?
translation: 有消息吗？

source: (They let this thing run loose? Well, if I don't get too close, it probably can't attack.)
translation: （他们竟让这东西四处乱跑？好吧，只要我别靠得太近，它大概就攻击不了我。）
notes: 主角把猫当危险动物，保留自我安慰式冷幽默。

source: [Exit]
translation: [退出]
notes: 三个共用语境均适用。

source: [Wait. When Linou is distracted, exit stage right.]
translation: [等待。趁莉努分神，从舞台右侧退场。]
notes: 保留 exit stage right 的戏剧化表达。

source: There's a kind of smoothness in her eyes, like water flowing behind a pane of glass. For a moment it is as if she's forgotten who I am.
translation: 她眼里有种异样的光滑，仿佛玻璃后有水流过。片刻间，她似乎忘了我是谁。
notes: 保留 smoothness 的不适感与玻璃后流水的意象。

source: Spencer's back.
translation: 斯宾塞回来了。

source: [Aubière makes a moue of distaste.] Just so. Among other things.
translation: [奥比耶嫌恶地撇了撇嘴。] 正是。还不止如此。
notes: moue 按面部动作译出。

source: ...anything by Spencer Hobson?
translation: ……有没有斯宾塞·霍布森写的东西？

source: [Consider the saint's signs and attributes.]
translation: [思量这位圣人的标志与象征。]
notes: attributes 依圣像学语境译“象征”。

source: That'll teach it.
translation: 这下它该长记性了。

source: Together, down the platform to the waiting carriages.
translation: 我们一同沿站台走向等候的车厢。

source: All right. But call me Spencer. That's my name now. Spencer Hobson. [Gain Vincent's positive Skill modifiers.]
translation: 好吧。不过叫我斯宾塞。这是我现在用的名字。斯宾塞·霍布森。[获得文森特的正面技艺修正。]
notes: Skill modifiers 依术语表译“技艺修正”。

source: [This thing is not respectful. Frighten it away.]
translation: [这东西毫无敬意。把它吓走。]

source: The woman in the chair is watching me curiously. I should at least speak to her before I begin interfering with her floor.
translation: 椅子里的女人正好奇地看着我。在摆弄她的地板之前，至少该先打声招呼。

source: Yes, sort of.
translation: 对，算是吧。

source: Who is she, then? What is she to you?
translation: 那她是谁？她跟你是什么关系？

source: Oh yes. She is so full of herself, that Lagasse. And an actress!
translation: 哦，没错。那个拉格斯，真是自命不凡。还是个女演员！
notes: 保留泽莉娅对“女演员”的鄙夷。

source: ...Jean-Bernard is right. The Stars are wrong.
translation: ……让-贝尔纳说得对。群星不对劲。
notes: Stars 大写，按天象异常处理为“群星”。

source: What I'd been taught, and what I learnt, didn't fit together.
translation: 别人教我的，和我亲身学到的，对不上。

source: Excuse me - madame -
translation: 打扰一下——夫人——
notes: 保留被打断的破折结构。

source: I mentioned earlier that I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation: 我先前提过，我在找一个叫[[Nina Lagasse]]的女人……
notes: 保留链接结构。

source: Mis-ter Hobson. Hi.
translation: 霍布森先——生。嗨。
notes: 用拖长“先生”模拟 Bessy 刻意纠正称呼时对 Mis-ter 的分音强调。

source: THE SHEAF. Dated 2nd November? As so often, now, the precise date resists the eye.
translation: 《禾捆》。日期是十一月二日？如今总是这样，确切日期总躲着人的眼睛。
notes: The Sheaf 依相邻批次开放终审采用《禾捆》；保留日期无法被准确看清的异常。

source: [The bookseller rests her chin on her fist and watches me. Blue smoke curls up from the cigarette in her mouth.]
translation: [书商用拳头托着下巴，注视着我。蓝烟从她唇间的香烟上袅袅升起。]

source: Sorry, Bessy. I don't know you well enough.
translation: 抱歉，贝茜。我跟你还没熟到那种程度。

source: [Watch him in silence.]
translation: [一言不发地看着他。]

source: As much theatre as anything. They're not advertising any booth shows, or beasts, or acrobats.
translation: 与其说是马戏，不如说更像戏剧。他们没有宣传任何棚场表演、珍禽异兽或杂技演员。
notes: booth shows 依巡回嘉年华语境开放终审采用“棚场表演”。

source: [Pass on, quickly.]
translation: [快步走过。]

source: Léon returns, smiling.
translation: 莱昂笑着回来了。

source: If that is so, I wish she had been less generous.
translation: 若真如此，我倒希望她别那么慷慨。

source: That painting - the mountain lake - looks a lot like one I saw in Hush House. Long ago now.
translation: 那幅画——那片山中湖泊——很像我很久以前在噤声居屋见过的一幅。
notes: Hush House 依术语表译“噤声居屋”。

source: That would be charming.
translation: 那就太好了。
notes: 2026.8.j.66 增量：对照新版资产、上下文与相邻旧译人工复核。

source: If we're finally now finished with the badinage, there's something I need to discuss with you.
translation: 若这番打趣总算结束了，我还有件正事要和你谈。
notes: badinage 依调情语境译“俏皮话”。

source: Here. [Pass him the pyx, but pocket the little jar you found in it.]
translation: 给。[把圣体盒递给他，但将从中发现的小陶罐揣进口袋。]
notes: pyx 依相邻批次统一译“圣体盒”。

source: Enough of the eyes of the saint for now.
translation: 暂且别再谈这位圣人的眼睛了。

source:
If there's one thing every adept has in common with every scholar... Curious choices are not necessarily wise.

[Evolve this Passion to Curiosity, which contributes Lantern and Knock to your Aspect Pool.]
translation:
若说每个修习者与每个学者都有一处相同……好奇之选未必明智。

[将这份心念演化为好奇心，为你的性相池贡献灯与启。]
notes: Passion、Curiosity、Lantern、Knock、Aspect Pool 依既有系统术语处理；严格保留换行。

source: Letterheads from an Incorporate entity called the Menninger Foundation, and from the European Recovery Program - the Acheson Mission. Both thank Aubière for his reports - though the ERP letter is much terser. Both discuss further funding... and Aubière is straightening up.
translation: 信笺抬头一份属于集团梅宁格基金会，另一份属于欧洲复兴计划——艾奇逊使团。两封都感谢奥比耶的报告，不过后者简短得多；也都谈到后续资助……奥比耶已经直起身来。
notes: ERP 首次写出中文全称；Menninger 与同批 Meninger 统一为“梅宁格”。

source: Is he tall? Short? How old?
translation: 他个子高？矮？多大年纪？

source: Bessy...
translation: 贝茜……

source: [Rodia frowns, stubs out her cigarette, lights another.] I don't know what that means. Although it doesn't sound like any state I'd choose.
translation: [罗迪娅皱起眉，掐灭香烟，又点上一支。] 我不知道那是什么意思。不过听起来，那绝不是我会选择的状态。
notes: state 在此为个人存在状态，非政治实体。

source: It might in fact serve as a sacrament for some heretical rites - [[Crucian]] or otherwise.
translation: 事实上，它或许能在某些异端仪式中充作圣礼——不论是[[Crucian]]的仪式，还是别的。
notes: 保留链接标识。

source: I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找一个叫[[Nina Lagasse]]的女人。
notes: 保留链接结构；五个共用语境均适用。

source: Not so very much older? I wish that's how I felt.
translation: 没有老多少？真希望我自己也这么觉得。

source: Indeed.
translation: 确实如此。

source: I knew there was something!
translation: 我就知道有问题！
notes: 根据举报/怀疑语境补足“有问题”。

source: Continue.
translation: 继续。

source: [Possessed] A little too giddy and dissipated for my tastes. I'd have preferred somewhere quieter.
translation: [着魔] 这地方有点太轻浮、太放纵，不合我的口味。我更喜欢安静些的去处。
notes: Possessed 在激情机制中依前批统一译“已有”。；润色2026-08-18：状态标签 [Possessed] 统一为“着魔”；“已有”系误读

source: I can't get into bed - I'm still fully dressed. [In a room of your own, you can change clothes at any time. To sleep, change to your dressing gown.]
translation: 我不能上床——还穿得整整齐齐。[在自己的房间里，随时可更衣。要睡觉，请换上睡袍。]
notes: 教程文本采用直接清晰语气。

source: [Dread <= 6] [Dread <= 6]
translation: [Dread <= 6] [Dread <= 6]
notes: k.83 开发占位条目（Dread 条件为未实装机制），恒等保留。

source: He ran with the zazous, you know? In Paris, during the [[Enemy]] occupation.
translation: 你知道吗？[[Enemy]]占领巴黎期间，他曾和扎祖派混在一起。
notes: 保留链接和富文本；zazous 指法国战时亚文化青年，开放终审采用“扎祖派”。

source: I reach out as if to brush something from her headband.
translation: 我伸出手，仿佛要从她的发带上拂去什么。

source: A strong state discourages frivolous chatter.
translation: 强势的邦国不鼓励无聊闲谈。
notes: state 为政治实体，开放终审依相邻批次译“邦国”。

source: [Leave, with a peremptory nod.]
translation: [不容置疑地点头，离开。]

source: There was an ending...
translation: 曾有过一个终局……
notes: 保留 Coseley 画作触发的含混回忆。

source: Light perpetual shine upon you.
translation: 愿永恒之光照耀于你。
notes: 采用安魂弥撒祷辞式表达。

source: [Lift the possibly-coffee that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation: [端起莉努替我放在托盘上的、也许算咖啡的东西。]
notes: 保留 possibly-coffee 的戏谑。

source: Do we have money?
translation: 我们有钱吗？
notes: 开发测试文本。

source: [The nearest card player snuffles merrily around his pipe.]
translation: [最近的牌客叼着烟斗，快活地哼笑起来。]

source: The train's whistle shrieks with joy, and then its engines drive it forward, into the night between cities.
translation: 汽笛欢快地尖啸一声，机车随即发力，载着我们驶入城市之间的夜。

source: But I would like to make a contribution to the Milice. Forty francisques.
translation: 不过，我愿意向民兵团捐款。四十弗朗西斯克。
notes: Milice 译“民团”；货币依前批开放终审采用“弗朗西斯克”。；润色2026-08-18：Milice 统一为“民兵团”

source: The Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. In the Cap d'Antibes, just past the park.
translation: “今日”疗养院。就在昂蒂布角，过了公园不远。
notes: Sanitarium Aujourd'hui 依相邻批次译“‘今日’疗养院”。

source: Perhaps this is something I'll choose later. Perhaps not. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation: 也许我以后会作出这个选择。也许不会。[暂时保留演化选项。]
notes: 系统文本。

source: I look forward to meeting again on the other side of sleep, shining one.
translation: 光辉者，我期待在睡眠的彼岸与你重逢。
notes: shining one 作为西农布尔称谓译“光辉者”。

source: [Dread >5] lorem ipsum dolor sit amet
translation: [Dread >5] lorem ipsum dolor sit amet
notes: k.83 开发占位条目（Dread 条件为未实装机制），恒等保留。

source: Then no. In Epirus one saw that sometimes. But Rodia, no.
translation: 那么，没有。在伊庇鲁斯，有时能见到那种情况。但罗迪娅没有。
notes: 保留 Rodia 以第三人称自称的疏离口吻。

source: Leopold does not trust easily.
translation: 利奥波德不会轻易相信别人。

source: "For behold, the Sun offers the waters of the sea as from a ewer..."
translation: “看哪，太阳倾献海水，如从执壶中倾出……”
notes: 保留经文式语气与 ewer 的水罐意象。

source: 'Behind your own image is a secret chamber with a beast-image...'
translation: “在你自己的影像背后，有一间密室，内藏野兽之像……”
notes: 保留 image/beast-image 的复沓。

source: [Aubière gives a tight smile, as if snapping closed a preferred hypothesis.] I am very sorry, M. Hobson, but any information I might have on Mlle Lagasse's whereabouts - that information is confidential.
translation: [奥比耶挤出一丝僵硬的笑，仿佛啪地合上一个中意的假设。] 非常抱歉，霍布森先生；但我手上凡是涉及拉格斯小姐去向的消息，都属机密。
notes: 保留 preferred hypothesis 被骤然合上的物质化比喻。

source: Very well...
translation: 很好……

source: A votive figure of the Sisterhood of the Triple Knot. I've only seen these in cave-shrines - beneath Meknes, beneath Alexandria, beneath [[Brancrug]].
translation: 一尊三重绳结姐妹会的还愿像。我只在洞窟神龛见过这种东西——梅克内斯地下、亚历山大港地下、[[Brancrug]]地下。
notes: Sisterhood of the Triple Knot 沿用《司辰之书》定名“三重绳结姐妹会”；保留地点链接。；v2.3.3 术语统一（亚历山大港/关系人，审计新登记术语检出）

source: Splash through a puddle - turn my ankle in a hidden hole -
translation: 踏水冲过一片水洼——脚踝却扭进暗藏的坑洞——
notes: 保留连续动作和句末中断。

source: I'm looking for a woman who was here in the Sanitarium. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation: 我在找一个曾住在疗养院的女人。[[Nina Lagasse]]。
notes: 保留链接结构。

source: Mrrrp.
translation: 喵呜。
notes: 猫叫拟声。

source: SINOMBRE, STRATHCOYNE, VLACHOU. RAVELINE? and LAGASSE.
translation: 西农布尔，斯特拉思科因，弗拉胡。拉维林？还有拉格斯。
notes: j.87 文本修订同步

source: Lose intentionally.
translation: 故意输掉。
notes: 牌局选项。

source: Prrp.
translation: 噗噜。
notes: 猫叫拟声，与 Mrrrp 区分。

source: Why -
translation: 为什么——
notes: 保留被打断语气。

source: What should we call you, Monsieur The Authorities? What alias are you using today to terrorise the innocent working men of Antibes?
translation: 我们该怎么称呼你，当局先生？你今天又用什么化名来恐吓昂蒂布无辜的劳动人民？
notes: Monsieur The Authorities 译“当局先生”，保留讽刺。

source: [Withdraw, for the moment.]
translation: [暂且退出。]

source: A great many years from now!
translation: 还要很多很多年呢！

source: [His eyes widen] I do hope that I remember this, when I am awake again.
translation: [他睁大双眼] 真希望再次醒来时，我还记得这件事。

source: Eh.
translation: 呃。

source: There are. But I am not easily frightened by dreams.
translation: 是有。不过，我可没那么容易被梦吓着。

source: Bye shoes
translation: 再见，鞋子
notes: 开发测试文本。

source: Only a way of saying: it is not palatable. It is burnt rice. Chicory root. And it is not cheap. Forty francisques.
translation: 说白了，就是难以下咽。焦米，菊苣根。而且还不便宜。四十弗朗西斯克。
notes: 货币译名沿前批。

source: And after consideration... I refuse it still.
translation: 而我考虑之后……仍旧拒绝。

source: 'A curse.'
translation: “诅咒。”
notes: 保留莱昂复述时的怀疑语气。

source: You kidding? I can't do this alone.
translation: 你开玩笑吧？这事我一个人干不了。

source: I imagine you will wish to leave without further delay. But I hope that you will return. You are an interesting man. I speak professionally, and otherwise.
translation: 我想，你会希望立即离开。不过我希望你还会回来。你是个有趣的人。这既是我的专业意见，也不只是专业意见。
notes: 保留末句含蓄的私人兴趣。

source: It would be cruel to point that out.
translation: 指出这一点未免太残忍。

source: The whole business is making him... surly. No sense of humour.
translation: 这桩事弄得他……脾气越发坏。毫无幽默感。

source: The cat suffers my touch, although no purr is forthcoming. The fur is very soft. The eyes are quite mad.
translation: 猫勉强容忍了我的触碰，却没有发出呼噜声。毛皮非常柔软。那双眼睛则疯得厉害。
notes: 保留末句突兀冷幽默。

source: She has another business - quieter even than bookselling. Mention my name to her, and perhaps she will help.
translation: 她还有另一门营生——甚至比卖书更安静。向她提我的名字，她或许会帮你。
notes: quieter business 保留隐晦说法。

source: My last name's Bloom. But I didn't go by Bloom, you know? Not for a while there.
translation: 我姓布卢姆。但你知道吗？有一阵子，我不用布卢姆这个姓。

source: I saved lives, wearing this.
translation: 我穿着这身衣服，救过人命。
notes: 与对应句“看着人们死去”保持镜像。

source: I wonder - I wonder if you find it comforting, perhaps. I mean that in these times, all of us must make hard choices - decisions about where to take our lives. While you are so fixated on Mlle Lagasse, you do not need to consider other matters. You are like a questing knight, perhaps, freed from the quotidian.
translation: 我在想——我在想，也许这反而让您感到安慰。我的意思是，在这样的时代，我们都得作出艰难的选择——决定自己的人生该去往何处。而当您如此执着于拉格斯小姐时，便不必考虑其他事情。您也许就像一位踏上征途的骑士，得以从日常琐事中解脱。
notes: j.87 文本修订同步

source: [Under this focused beam of bonhomie, Mathis unbends very slightly.] Euh.
translation: [这股热情专照着他轰，马蒂斯总算略微松动。] 呃。
notes: 保留 focused beam 的光束比喻和 Mathis 的克制反应。

source: The director is a man in distinguished middle age with a look of sleek intelligence. His hair, his nails, his smile are all extremely clean.
translation: 院长正值体面的中年，神情圆滑而精明。他的头发、指甲和笑容，全都干净得过了头。
notes: 用“干净得过了头”保留细节带来的不适感。；润色2026-08-18：Director 统一为“院长”

source: Philomèle sips her wine, smiling very slightly.
translation: 菲洛梅勒轻啜葡萄酒，露出极浅的微笑。

source: I apologise. I couldn't afford to lose. I didn't want to admit how limited my funds were.
translation: 抱歉。我输不起。我只是不愿承认自己的钱实在有限。

source: Very busy.
translation: 非常忙。

source: Spend [q=ang:evolveCost] Forge Experiences.
translation: 花费 [q=ang:evolveCost] 份铸之经历。
notes: 保留变量；沿既有系统句式。

source: Jean-Bernard needs cheering up. You seem fine.
translation: 让-贝尔纳需要人哄他开心。你看起来好得很。

source: [Cough some more.]
translation: [再咳几声。]

source: You were born in the Republic, you mean? You are a stranger in the State?
translation: 你是说，你出生在共和国？如今在邦国成了异乡人？
notes: Republic/State 指战前共和国与当下邦国的政体更替；State 开放终审采用“邦国”。

source: Got to, don't you?
translation: 总得这样，不是吗？
notes: 愤世嫉俗激情分支中的自我辩解。

source: You are mortal. And ignorant. Nothing you say can approach what a Lantern-long feels.
translation: 你是凡人。又无知。你的言语根本触及不了灯之长生者的感受。
notes: Lantern-long 依前作体系译“灯之长生者”。

source: What charming money you have, [q=alias.formal].
translation: 你的钱可真迷人，[q=alias.formal]。
notes: 保留称呼变量及牌局赢家的挖苦。

source: [Consider ordering something.]
translation: [考虑点些什么。]

source: You can't tell me what your old friend looks like?
translation: 你不能告诉我，你那位老朋友长什么样吗？

source: Are you a patient here? Or a prisoner?
translation: 你是这里的病人？还是囚犯？

source: Tastes like what it tastes like. But there is a power in it. Keeps the spidermist from you.
translation: 喝起来就那样。不过里面有股力量，能让蛛雾离你远些。
notes: spidermist 依相邻批次统一译“蛛雾”。

source: The Plague of Leaves? A little. When I rise. No wood is quite so pliable as flesh. And so I rarely venture from this room. My view is charming, but I tire of it. And so I greet all visitors as friends. Even the ones like Fraser and his pet.
translation: 叶疫？有一点。我起身时便会发作。再没有什么木料比血肉更柔顺，所以我很少离开这间屋子。窗外景致虽好，我也看厌了。因此，来客我一概当朋友欢迎——哪怕是弗雷泽和他的宠物。
notes: Plague of Leaves 依前批译“叶疫”；保留木材向血肉弯曲的异变逻辑。

source: Mm.
translation: 嗯。
notes: 三个共用语境均适用。

source: What's the game?
translation: 这玩的是什么？
notes: 牌局语境。

source: A very little sin. And I'm sorry that I've come to you in this sordid way. Tell me what I need to know, and we need never speak of it again.
translation: 一桩极小的罪过。也很抱歉，竟用这种下作的法子找上你。把我要知道的告诉我，此后我们谁也不必再提。
notes: 保留富文本强调与勒索式委婉语气。

source: One should not smoke in here. It is bad for the books.
translation: 这里不该抽烟。对书不好。

source: À bientôt.
translation: 回头见。
notes: 法语告别语按显示文本译出，保留富文本。

source: Very good.
translation: 很好。

source: The wood of the chair has begun to bow and twist yearningly towards the flesh of her legs.
translation: 椅子的木料开始弯曲、扭转，渴慕地探向她双腿的血肉。
notes: 保留木材对血肉产生渴望的身体恐怖意象。

source: [Bow my head and withdraw.]
translation: [低头退开。]

source: You remind me, monsieur, of a man I knew long ago. Before the Wars.
translation: 先生，您让我想起一位很久以前的故人。那是在诸战之前。
notes: Wars 依世界观保留复数概念，译“诸战”。

source: She wears black, certainly.
translation: 她确实穿着黑衣。

source: Well, look around. Everyone's had a rough time. You live with it, or you go under.
translation: 看看四周吧。谁没遭过罪？要么带着它活下去，要么沉下去。
notes: 保留 go under 的下沉意象。

source: FNORD you're that nun!
translation: FNORD 你就是那个修女！
notes: 保留开发占位标记 FNORD。

source: Excuse me.
translation: 打扰了。
notes: 三个共用语境均适用。

source: I have nothing to say about monsieur le Directeur.
translation: 关于院长先生，我无话可说。
notes: 保留 Mathis 拒绝谈论院长的正式口吻。；润色2026-08-18：Directeur 统一为“院长”

source: Well, then. I didn't tell you everything before.
translation: 那么，好吧。我先前没有把一切都告诉你。

source: St Guinefort. A potent allegory.
translation: 圣吉内福尔。一个有力的寓言。

source: [Nod neutrally.]
translation: [不动声色地点头。]

source: Leave it for now.
translation: 暂且放着。
notes: 保险柜与陶罐两个共用语境均适用。

source: Coca-Cola, hm? You get many Americans here?
translation: 可口可乐，嗯？这里常有美国人来？

source: When he and I made the arrangement to supply my special requirements, Mr Hobson. This is the world we live in; but it is not an arrangement that an honest man would have offered me.
translation: 是在他答应满足我的特殊需要时，霍布森先生。世道如此；但正直的人不会向我提出这种交易。

source: Well... good.
translation: 那……很好。

source: I never really understood that.
translation: 我一直不太明白那是什么意思。

source: The ticket-inspector was smoking Gitanes all the way from Milan...
translation: 检票员从米兰一路都在抽吉塔娜牌香烟……
notes: Gitanes 依相邻批次译“吉塔娜牌”。

source: Hush. He's quoting Mazarine.
translation: 嘘。他在引用马扎林。
notes: Mazarine 开放终审按人名音译；后文与 Mallarmé 构成误认笑话。

source: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？

source: Oh yes. They'll remember my name for a long, long time.
translation: 哦，当然。他们会记住我的名字，很久，很久。
notes: 野心激情语境，保留重复。

source: [I've already learnt all I can here.]
translation: [这里能查的，我都查完了。]

source: No. I mean that when you're ordained, it kindles a light in the soul. Exalts the phost. That can't be undone. I can still perform sacraments. But I haven't, in... a long time. Almost thirty years.
translation: 不。我的意思是，领受圣职时，灵魂中会燃起一道光，使明识升华。这件事无法撤销。我依然能施行圣礼。只是已经……很久没做过了。快有三十年。
notes: phost 沿用《司辰之书》九大魂质的既有译名“明识”；保留富文本。

source: Well? No, no, not for some time now. Thank you for asking.
translation: 安好？不，不，早就谈不上了。多谢关心。
notes: 承接“您还好吗”，保留海梅闪烁其词的回答。

source: I also have an ailment.
translation: 我身上也有毛病。

source: You had your free drinks, and my business cannot wait. Let's not pretend we're family.
translation: 免费的酒你已经喝过，而我的事不能再等。别装得像我们是一家人。

source: Yes. I often pass them on my constitutional walk. 'Janvier,' I say to myself. 'These are bad times. I had never expected to outlive any city that I called home.'
translation: 是。我照例散步时常经过那里。“让维耶，”我对自己说，“世道不好。我从没想过，自己竟会比每一座叫过家园的城市活得更久。”
notes: constitutional 依旧式用语译“例行散步”；保留老人比城市长寿的沉重意象。

source: Make her suffer.
translation: 让她受苦。

source: Oho! A vendetta on la marquise! There will be blood!
translation: 哦豁！要向侯爵夫人寻仇！这下要见血了！
notes: 保留富文本与阿里斯蒂德夸张起哄的口吻。

source: Try a charm on the window - to separate or excise conflicting influences.
translation: 试着对窗户施一道咒术——分离或剔除彼此冲突的影响。

source: Examine the box for hidden catches.
translation: 检查盒子上有没有暗扣。

source: Fortunately for you... I suspect you are no gentleman at all, but a scoundrel. One knows where one is, with scoundrels.
translation: 算你走运……我怀疑你根本不是什么绅士，而是个恶棍。跟恶棍打交道，至少心里有底。
notes: 末句按英式习语意译，保留安德蕾冷峻的认可。

source: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be impertinent. It was a botanical enquiry.
translation: 抱歉，我无意冒犯。只是出于植物学上的好奇。
notes: 将 botanical enquiry 的一本正经保留为冷幽默。

source: Who was she?
translation: 她是谁？

source: No. But not through choice.
translation: 没有。但并非出于我的选择。

source: [Murmur a protective charm.]
translation: [低声念诵防护咒语。]

source: That's long after he painted his Pierrots. And long after I left the world. I have no idea if he was even in Antibes then.
translation: 那是在他画下那些皮埃罗很久以后。也是在我离开尘世很久以后。我甚至不知道当时他是否身在昂蒂布。
notes: Pierrots 指毕加索笔下的皮埃罗形象。

source: Lift up your heart, my friend. The saint is patient, and so am I.
translation: 举心向上，我的朋友。圣人很有耐心，我也一样。
notes: Lift up your heart 采用礼仪祷辞式“举心向上”。

source: There is a story, you know. They took some Charlemagnes - the turncoats, you know, the Enemy volunteers - in the last days of the war. They asked the Charlemagnes how they could stand to wear German uniforms.
translation: 你知道，有这么一个故事。战争最后几天，他们抓住了几个“查理曼”——就是那些叛徒，那些投奔敌人的志愿兵。他们问这些“查理曼”，怎么受得了穿德国制服。
notes: Charlemagnes 指历史上的查理曼师成员，以引号保留代称；Enemy 按大写阵营实体译“敌人”。

source: [Wait impassively. Don't rise to the bait.]
translation: [不动声色地等着。不上她的钩。]
notes: 保留 bait 的钓饵意象。

source: [Vincent shivers - though with what emotion is not immediately obvious.]
translation: [文森特打了个寒战——却一时看不出是出于何种情绪。]

source: Exactly! We had an election - not only an election, but a select and refined election! Free of Icarians and un...patriots! A republican distillate, my friends. Like wine to cognac. Oh, the cognac is perhaps a little rough on the throat. Perhaps the hangover is -
translation: 正是！我们举行了一场选举——不只是选举，更是精挑细选、提纯升华的选举！没有伊加利亚派，也没有不……爱国者！朋友们，这是共和国的蒸馏精华。就像葡萄酒蒸成干邑。哦，干邑也许有点辣嗓子。宿醉也许——
notes: 保留 select/refined/distillate 与葡萄酒、干邑的连续政治双关。

source: Frost glitters on the brick walls as we pass. The corridor grows narrower towards the end.
translation: 我们经过时，砖墙上的霜闪闪发亮。走廊越到尽头越窄。

source: [Take stock of the arm.]
translation: [仔细审视那条手臂。]

source: She sings?
translation: 她唱歌？

source: Uh... [Bessy, confused, looks around, spotting a coffee-pot behind her.]
translation: 呃……[贝茜困惑地四下张望，看见身后有一只咖啡壶。]

source: [Consider my papers - what do I have?]
translation: [想想我的证件——我手上有什么？]

source: [Stand up abruptly; drop the pyx clattering on his desk; stalk out.]
translation: [猛地起身；任圣体盒哐当一声落在他的书桌上；大步离开。]
notes: pyx 依前批统一译“圣体盒”。

source: [q=alias.formal.fr]. Welcome back. How may I assist you today?
translation: [q=alias.formal.fr]。欢迎回来。今天需要我为您做些什么？
notes: 保留法语正式称呼变量。

source: [Nothing more to do here. Just take the drinks back over to the poet, the painter, and ...whatever the other two are.]
translation: [这里没别的事可做了。只管把酒端回去，给诗人、画家，还有……不知该算什么的另外两位。]
notes: 保留主角对另外两人的轻慢停顿。

source: [Back into the park.]
translation: [回到公园。]

source: The crawling feel of half-grown whiskers -like dirt beneath the nails or tinny music half-heard - until it's gone, the aggravation is almost imperceptible.
translation: 半长胡茬爬在脸上的感觉——像指甲缝里的泥，像隐约传来的尖薄乐声——在它消失以前，几乎察觉不到那份烦躁。
notes: 保留“去除后才察觉不适”的细微身体感受；源文缺空格按标点处理。

source: 'Beneath the skin of the world we find the Mansus, also called the World-Spine, also called the House of the Sun. Above the House is the [[Glory]], the origin of light, to which souls aspire. At the foot of the House, and around its walls - though it has no walls - is the [[Wood]].'
translation: “在世界的表皮之下，我们寻得漫宿，亦称世界之脊，亦称太阳的居屋。居屋之上是[[Glory]]：光之源，众魂向往之所。居屋脚下、墙垣四周——尽管它没有墙——则是[[Wood]]。”
notes: Mansus、House of the Sun、Glory、Wood 均依术语表；保留两处链接结构。

source: [Open the fridge.]
translation: [打开冰箱。]

source: Submit.
translation: 屈服。
notes: 睡眠内部选项，与 Fight/Struggle 对照。

source: [Edge] Menacing.
translation: [刃] 威胁重重。
notes: Edge 依术语表译“刃”。

source: The Sanitarium wanted a bit of local colour.
translation: 疗养院想添一点本地风情。

source: [Pass through the door.]
translation: [穿过门。]

source: Now just let your thoughts wander, just open your eyes. It's so bright, is it not? It's so clear.
translation: 现在只管放任思绪，只管睁开眼。很亮，不是吗？很清楚。
notes: 保留催眠式重复。

source: A nineteenth century relic.
translation: 十九世纪的遗物。
notes: 操守心念分支中的贬抑判断。

source: One more thing. We were to discuss [[Nina Lagasse]] when our business was done.
translation: 还有一件事。我们说好，交易结束后便谈[[Nina Lagasse]]。
notes: 保留链接结构。

source: Ironic applause from the card-players' table.
translation: 牌客那桌传来讥讽的掌声。

source: [Incline my head and stay.]
translation: [微微颔首，留下。]
所以……？

source: [You're surrendering to your Appetite. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation: [你正放任自己求取餍足。不过人总会变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。]
notes: Steam 官方简中将 Appetite 定为“餍足”；按中文句法改写 surrender to。

source: Dr Aubière is an 'ignoramus'? He has his flaws, but he's an educated man, surely.
translation: 奥比耶医生是个“无知之徒”？他固然有缺点，到底受过教育。

source: He sneezes.
translation: 他打了个喷嚏。
notes: 承接莱昂“嗅出谎言”的喜剧动作。

source: ...waving at a railway sleeper and expecting the station to change position.
translation: ……向一根铁轨枕木挥手，指望车站换个位置。
notes: 保留神学比喻中无效因果的荒诞。

source: Sorry. Can't talk about... it. Gives it power. But you'll be fine. It won't hurt another resident.
translation: 抱歉。不能谈……它。那会给它力量。不过你不会有事。它不会伤害另一个住客。
notes: 保留 it 指代不明及 Vincent 的停顿。

source: A panel of dark wood, daubed with the symbol of a closed eye. It resembles the door of the sanitarium living room; but it isn't actually a door, or I would be able to open it.
translation: 一块深色木板，潦草画着闭眼的符号。它很像疗养院起居室的门；但它并不真是门，否则我就能将它打开。

source: Silk scarf, heavy high-waisted woollen trousers, a merino wool submariner jumper, a gabardine drill trench coat. Made to measure for colder climates.
translation: 丝巾，厚重的高腰羊毛长裤，美利奴羊毛潜艇兵毛衣，华达呢斜纹风衣。为寒冷气候量身定制。
notes: 保留战间期服装材质与军装式样细节。

source: The heart of a pet? Did you take its life with your own hands?
translation: 一只宠物的心脏？是你亲手取了它的性命？

source: [I hesitate. Vincent listens.]
translation: [我犹豫了。文森特听着。]

source: Here's a mean little door, badly painted in distemper-yellow.
translation: 这里有一扇寒酸的小门，草草刷成了粉胶漆的黄色。
notes: distemper 指廉价粉胶涂料，保留门的寒碜质感。

source: Here. Do you know what is a 'pyx'? [Aubière is vertical again.]
translation: 看这个。你知道什么是“圣体盒”吗？[奥比耶又坐直了。]
notes: pyx 依前批译“圣体盒”；vertical 指他警觉地恢复挺直坐姿。

source: Hans Emmenegger, 'Waldinneres' / 'Inner Forest', 1933 (oil, canvas)
translation: 汉斯·埃门内格尔，《森林内部》／《林中深处》，1933年（布面油画）
notes: 保留原题与英译题的双题结构，并沿对话中 Emmenegger 的既有译名。

source: Gate, Horizontal
translation: 门，横着的
notes: 保留 Gate, Horizontal 的逗号停顿与把床一本正经归类为横门的冷幽默。

source: No refunds for the horizon
translation: 地平线概不退款
notes: 已用完整短语、单复数变体及诗歌限定检索，未发现早于或独立于游戏的可靠文本见证；开放终审判定为针对 HORIZON 海报的游戏原创题辞，不能标作诗句。

source: No Newspaper
translation: 没有报纸
notes: k.83 由 [Paperless] 改为 No Newspaper（去选项括号）。

source: Tall, severe, imperious. Clearly once a great beauty.
translation: 高挑，严厉，威势逼人。显然曾是一位绝色美人。
notes: 无上下文人物短描述。

source: 'If it were possible to do away with dreaming altogether - if only it were possible - '
translation: “如果能彻底不再做梦——要是能就好了——”
notes: 保留原句踌躇、复沓的语气。

source: That Glorious Gleam
translation: 那辉煌的烁
notes: Gleam 依术语表作准则名“烁”。

source: Think of myself as a physician
translation: 把自己视作医生
notes: 对话选项短标签。

source: First Class
translation: 一等座
notes: 车厢等级。；润色2026-08-18：一等座统一

source: [Back] Those in peril on the sea, anyway.
translation: [返回] 总之，是那些在海上遇险的人。
notes: 承接圣雷帕拉塔守护对象。

source: A burly gentleman in orderly's whites.
translation: 一位身材魁梧、穿着白色护工制服的绅士。
notes: 无上下文人物短描述。

source: Zazou Once
translation: 从前的扎祖
notes: 与“扎祖当年”成对：前者落在身份，后者落在时间。

source: I can keep it for myself or render it to someone else - once I've achieved it.
translation: 等我得到它，既可留给自己，也可转交别人。
notes: 无上下文目标说明；render 依交付物语境译“交给”。

source: Compassionate?
translation: 心怀同情？
notes: 对应激情“同情”。

source: Sister Pancrata
translation: 潘克拉塔修女
notes: 人名音译。

source: Maintain an appropriate distance.
translation: 保持适当距离。

source: Meeting Miss Naenia: for a Favour
translation: 会见奈尼娅小姐：为一份人情
notes: 任务标题；Favour 开放终审采用“人情”。

source: Mathis described hidden office
translation: 马蒂斯提过隐藏的办公室
notes: 条件标签。

source: But as a draft excluder, perhaps it has promise
translation: 不过，拿来堵门缝，或许还有点用处
notes: draft excluder 指挡门缝的防风物；保留对纹丝不动之猫的干冷玩笑。

source: Pearls
translation: 珍珠

source: Joyous Remnant
translation: 欢欣遗民
notes: 无上下文专名，开放终审采用“欢欣遗民”。

source:
Why should a man, whose blood is warm within,
Sit like his grandsire cut in alabaster?
translation:
一个体内尚有热血的人，为何
要像他那白石雕成的祖父般枯坐？
notes: 保留莎士比亚引文的两行、一次换行及两处回车。

source: Insights into Aubière from investigating his dream
translation: 探查奥比耶之梦所得的见解
notes: 多处梦境对话共用的条件/效果标签。

source: 'I never knew the old Vienna before the war with its Strauss music, its glamour and easy charm. Constantinople suited me better. I really got to know it in the classic period of the black market. We'd run anything if people wanted it enough...' (Greene)
translation: “我从未见过战前的老维也纳，不知道它的施特劳斯乐曲、它的绚烂与从容魅力。我更中意君士坦丁堡。我真正熟悉那里，正是在黑市的黄金时代。只要人们想要得够厉害，什么我们都运……”（格林）
notes: 保留走私者对维也纳与君士坦丁堡的反向怀旧及省略收束。

source: The Lady, Afterwards
translation: 女士，后来
notes: 呼应 Weather Factory 既有作品名 The Lady Afterwards 的核心构词，同时保留本作逗号造成的悬置；不擅加指示词“那位”。

source: Beneath the Day
translation: 白昼之下
notes: 睡眠章节题，保留空间化意象。

source: State Passport
translation: 邦国护照
notes: State 开放终审依相邻批次译“邦国”。

source: A narrow-eyed, watchful woman in a crisp uniform
translation: 一位眯着双眼、警惕戒备、制服笔挺的女人
notes: 无上下文人物短描述。

source: Mason wants me to give him the Thunderskin's Sign, once I've recovered it from the temenos at Antibes.
translation: 梅森希望我从昂蒂布圣域取回轰雷之皮的征象后，将它交给他。
notes: Thunderskin 依术语表译“轰雷之皮”；temenos 开放终审采用“圣域”。

source: Ela wants me to give her the Thunderskin's Sign, once I've recovered it from the temenos at Antibes.
translation: 艾拉希望我从昂蒂布圣域取回轰雷之皮的征象后，将它交给她。
notes: Thunderskin 依术语表译“轰雷之皮”；temenos 开放终审采用“圣域”。

source: - Ys -
translation: - 伊斯 -
notes: 地点专名。

source:
GRATIA CAELI ADESTO SAVINAE DE PETRADVRA PER QVAM SVM FACTA FIGURA
 May heaven's grace attend Savina of the Unyielding Stone, through whom I achieved this form.
translation:
GRATIA CAELI ADESTO SAVINAE DE PETRADVRA PER QVAM SVM FACTA FIGURA
 愿上天恩典眷顾不屈之石萨维娜，我因她而成此形。
notes: 拉丁题铭原样保留；严格保留换行后的前导空格与末尾回车。

source: Decent?
translation: 还算正派？
notes: 结合 Honourable 分支对“做正确之事”的界定，不直译为品级。

source: My Bonnie lies under the ocean
translation: 我的爱人，沉睡海底
notes: 改写自传统民歌《My Bonnie Lies over the Ocean》首句：游戏把 over 改作 under，译文以“沉睡海底”保留溺亡暗示。

source: The tired, laconic, watchful patronne of Chez Felix.
translation: 菲利克斯之家那位疲惫、寡言而警觉的女店主。
notes: Chez Felix 统一作“菲利克斯之家”；保留富文本与末尾空格。

source: Nine
translation: 九

source: The butcher of Mimata: clean, trim, rufous.
translation: 米马塔的屠夫：整洁，精干，红发。
notes: 无上下文人物短描述；rufous 按发色处理。

source: Maître Argant
translation: 阿尔冈律师
notes: 法语 Maître 在此人物、书信与婚姻语境中是对律师的职业敬称，统一译“律师”。

source: The shadow of a shadow
translation: 影之影
notes: 保留 Shadowed Place 的递归意象，凝练处理。

source: An obscure blue-silver presence.
translation: 一团晦暗的蓝银色存在。
notes: l.31 新增；沿用既有变体“卡昂一团晦暗的蓝银色存在。”的去地点版。

source: Always in graceful motion; always, softly, humming.
translation: 永远举止优雅；永远在轻轻哼着歌。
notes: l.31 新增角色描述。

source: - join with the Chandler -
translation: - 与制烛人会合 -
notes: The Chandler 沿《司辰之书》《制烛人之愿》既有译名。

source: Ambitious?
translation: 心怀野心？
notes: 对应激情“野心”。

source: Vessel, provisioner, warder
translation: 容器，供养者，守卫者
notes: 保留三重职能并列与 enceinte 的围护语境。

source: Detective-Ostiary Douglas Moore. Some day, they might let him retire, but at this point it might be easier to die, really.
translation: 侦探兼司阍道格拉斯·摩尔。也许有朝一日，他们会准他退休；不过事到如今，说真的，死掉或许还容易些。
notes: Ostiary 原指司门者，结合复合职衔开放终审采用“司阍”。

source: A statue? An automaton?
translation: 一尊雕像？一具自动人偶？

source: D.O. Moore
translation: D.O. 摩尔
notes: 保留职衔缩写。

source: All the wars were difficult for us all. Let's leave it at that. When you're ready to know more about me, and when I'm ready to tell you, we'll talk.
translation: 每一场战争，对我们每个人都不好过。就说到这里。等你准备好问、我也准备好答，我们再谈。
notes: 保留对战争经历的克制回避。

source: Jaime Huguet, 'Archangel St. Michael', 1486 (print, originally tempera on wood)
translation: 海梅·乌格特，《大天使圣米迦勒》，1486年（版画，原作为木板蛋彩画）
notes: 按画作铭牌格式处理。

source: Neutral
translation: 中性
notes: i.75 新增对话语气标签；对应直呼名字的中性说法，采用简洁 UI 用语。；润色2026-08-18：Neutral 统一

source: Noted for diffident elegance.
translation: 以怯生生的优雅著称。
notes: l.31 新增角色描述。

source:
FINIS SOMNIUM EST UNDE NON EVIGILAMUS
The end is a dream from which there is no waking. (Drndić)
translation:
FINIS SOMNIUM EST UNDE NON EVIGILAMUS
终结是一场无法醒来的梦。（德尔恩迪奇）
notes: 拉丁题铭原样保留；保留不可醒转的终局语气。

source:
'The hands and space of hyacinth / Paling in the confines of the Ghetto /  Almost do not exist for the quiet man / Who dreams a shining labyrinth.'
(Borges, 'Spinoza')
translation:
“风信子的双手与空间 / 在犹太区的囚笼里渐失颜色 /  对沉静的人而言，近乎并不存在 / 他梦见一座辉耀的迷宫。”
（博尔赫斯，《斯宾诺莎》）
notes: 保留诗行的三处回车、斜线分行及一处换行；人名与篇名采用通行译法。

source: Surveillante Odette
translation: 督导奥黛特
notes: Surveillante 为女性监管职衔，开放终审采用“督导”。

source: Zazou When
translation: 扎祖当年
notes: 与“曾是扎祖”成对，点出马蒂斯的往昔。

source: Until Antipolis
translation: 直至安提波利斯
notes: Antipolis 是昂蒂布古名，标题保留古称以呈现抵达前的历史纵深。

source: Sniff Test
translation: 嗅闻测试
notes: 陶罐检查选项。

source: Seeking Nina
translation: 寻找宁娜
notes: 任务/话题标签。

source: Sorrow-shadowed?
translation: 哀伤笼罩？
notes: 对应激情“悲恸”，保留 shadowed 意象。 机制对话标题中的 Sorrow 统一为‘哀伤’。

source: Sister Servata
translation: 塞尔瓦塔修女
notes: 人名音译。

source: Already seen a tin of actual coffee in Linou's fridge
translation: 已经在莉努的冰箱里见过一罐真咖啡
notes: 条件标签。
